Hi Mrs./Miss Johnson,

It's me across the alley, just checking on how that tree outside is doing.

So I went for that morning stroll yesterday, just for the exercise and fresh morning vibes. On one stretch of my routine walk I spotted your magnolias and I was pleasantly stunned to see that their flowers were blooming so nicely! 

It was just a quick glimpse since we are not in each othr's front yard but they sure did catch some eye appeal as it made my early morning rounds.

Hope it has also given some delight for those passing and living around. It's a good thing we all got trees to enjoy in these urban settings! Enjoy your blooms. 😍✨ Have some more lovely days coming soon. 🥄🌱✨
  

Kindly regards!  
Your friendly neighbourhood neighbor 🎈🏡💕
